method: Parse committed and current YAML; require exact equality after normalizing only power/dac region rectangles and removing exactly the two validated board.drc_rules. All other board, floorplan, electrical, component, model, and fixed-anchor inputs must be identical.

after: (rule "U204 internal pad clearance" (condition "A.Type == 'Pad' && B.Type == 'Pad' && A.memberOfFootprint('U204') && B.memberOfFootprint('U204')") (constraint clearance (min 0.15mm)))
(rule "U336 internal pad clearance" (condition "A.Type == 'Pad' && B.Type == 'Pad' && A.memberOfFootprint('U336') && B.memberOfFootprint('U336')") (constraint clearance (min 0.15mm)))

interpretation: Existing electrical results apply to identical circuit/model inputs. This is an exact input-equivalence check, not a new simulation run. Rule exception applies only to pad pairs within U204 or within U336.
